in_marathi.name: Piklu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Piklu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Piklu is derived from the Bengali language, which means 'small mango'. This name is often given to a baby girl born during the mango season, symbolizing the joy and happiness that comes with the arrival of the fruit.
